title_en: CLEARING DEAL! On Siri Kodra Street, 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale With Lots of Light!
description_en: CLEARING DEAL! On Siri Kodra Street, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale, very close to New Boulevard! The apartment is located on the 2nd floor and facing West! The property has a fully utilized and very neat floor plan, consisting of a separate kitchen, living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment is expected to be completed at the end of 2025. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas, quite quiet and with all the facilities for a comfortable life.
